review_comment: Can this lock granularity be optimized to queue id level?  Don't see the need for a larger lock.
In most scenarios, it is recommended to use pop broker(-1), and there is a unnessary cost of repeatedly locking and unlocking when there are a large number of queues

Here isRetrieveMessageFromPopRetryTopicV1 and isEnableRetryTopicV2 may be established at the same time in compatible scenarios. At this time, when processing getMessageFuture here, will it always use isEnableRetryTopicV2?
In the final version, the v2 format is used only. During the retry topic format transfer phase, there may be unconsumed retry messages in the v1 topic.
Although it has nothing to do with this time, it seems that line 226 is impossible to reach here?
I use put if not exist method here. This code is equivalent to the original. Maybe there was originally a value of 0?
